notes.title: 🌍 What is Plastic Footprint? 🌊
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41543593/82ab0fd1f9c8d07936332bb5928a5a866d2371fa.png[/img]

[b]Plastic footprint[/b] is the amount of plastic waste we generate and leave behind in the environment. [i]Every plastic bag, bottle, and straw we use[/i] adds to this growing problem, and unfortunately, a lot of it ends up in the ocean.

🐢[b] Which species are in danger?[/b] It’s not just turtles who mistake plastic for food. Dolphins can get tangled in discarded fishing nets, and seabirds often feed plastic pieces to their young. Even the tiniest creatures, like plankton, are at risk, as they ingest microplastics that work their way up the food chain, impacting ecosystems far beyond the ocean depths. The plastic doesn't just disappear—it spreads.

🌊 Our oceans are in danger, and with them, so are we. The plastic footprint we leave behind grows every day. But here's the question: How can we reduce it?

💡 Tell us in the comments [b]how YOU think we can lower our plastic footprint! [/b]One easy way is by using reusable bottles—oh, and maybe playing Global City? 😉 For those who share their ideas, there just might be a reward waiting for you! 🎁

Mayor, the transport system of your city keeps on developing every day, and now you'll have a chance to start constructing a true passenger port! Soon, you'll be able to present the residents of Global City a wonderful opportunity to sail on magnificent liners and enjoy sea views.
Complete Event Pass or complete orders to get Transport tokens and implement transport projects.
Make your city comfortable for your residents! The event starts on September 27.

notes.title: Wheel of Fortune
notes.content:
Get ready to test your luck!
Wheel of Fortune is about to start. You'll have a chance to spin it and get valuable rewards! Check how lucky you are!
Wait till the Wheel appears and try your hand. You'll surely like it! 
The event starts on September 26.

notes.title: Quick contests
notes.content:
We announce Quick Contests, a high-speed cargo race, in Global City again! Get ready to take part along with mayors of other cities, complete tasks without leaving the game, load your ships and get valuable rewards.
You can't miss this tournament! The rewards will be great!
The event starts on September 23.

notes.title: In the path of the tornado
notes.content:
Alarm! Code red! A terrible tornado is getting closer to Global City.
Get ready to protect your city! A powerful cruiser with advanced weapons is waiting for you in your arsenal. It can stop the hurricane due to targeted explosions. But to make this plan work you should assemble a lot of collections. Who will handle this important task if not you? Rush to the game, become a hero, and get rewards!
The event will start on September 19.

notes.title: Quick Contests
notes.content:
Become the leader of Quick Contests!
Get ready to begin the race for the title of the most effective mayor! Load ships, send them to sail, be the first among the neighbors and get rewards right here and now.
You can be the winner! The event starts on September 16.

notes.title: Passenger Railroad
notes.content:
Mayor, soon you'll have a chance to start constructing a new passenger railroad! Your citizens can't wait to take a ride on modern trains, check out the comfort of the brand new stations and admire the original architecture of the station. Just imagine how much time you can save to get to the other side of the city within minutes!
Complete tasks or cargo orders and get Passenger Railroad Tokens to construct the Railroad.
Make your city even more comfortable! The event starts on September 13.

notes.title: Rewards for luck
notes.content:
An amazing Wheel of Fortune is ready to appear in the game again!
Rush to Global City to test your luck! Spin the Wheel of Fortune and see what rewards you'll get. You will have a chance to get the Gold Chest containing a wonderful architectural masterpiece for your city. Other rewards are also great!
Make your city even more beautiful!
The event starts on September 12.

notes.title: New challenge
notes.content:
Quick Contests is your way to success!
Load and send as many ships as possible to outrun other mayors in the group. Take the lead and get rewards!
Improve your city through the gambling competition and your own commitment!
The event starts on September 9.

notes.title: Tasks for unions
notes.content:
Mayor, get ready to new challenges! Now you will be able to complete tasks with your union and get rewards. Complete tasks, get clan and personal points and claim prizes.
Help your union and get as many rewards as possible!

notes.title: Mine opens again
notes.content:
Great news: the mysterious mine begins work in the outskirts of the city!
Nobody knows how and when it opens... Yet, one thing is clear: it still has plenty of treasures! Get ready to dig for gold ore and mineral resources! Get items to develop the city as a reward!
Don't waste a moment, the mine will be closed again!

notes.title: Contests for mayors
notes.content:
Quick Contests are ready to launch  in the game again!
Get ready to take part in the race of the most enterprising and strong mayors. Load ships, send them out and beat rivals in your group. You should do it all as fast as you can to get great rewards!
Are you ready to prove you're fast, effective, and won't stop? Then come on! The event starts on September 2.

notes.title: Rewards for lucky
notes.content:
You will get another great chance to tempt fate and get rewards, just sping the Wheel of Fortune!
Among the rewards, you'll be able to get true masterpieces of world architecture from Gold Chests and many other items.
Use every opportunity to make your city even more beautiful!
The event will start on August 29.

notes.title: Quick contests
notes.content:
A great race for the most adventurous mayors!
Quick Contests, a high-speed cargo race, are about to launch in Global City! Take part along with mayors of other cities, complete tasks without leaving the game, load your ships and get valuable rewards.
You can't miss this tournament! Show everyone what you can do and be the first in your group. The rewards will be great!
The event will start on August 26.

notes.title: Iceberg
notes.content:
Help! A gigantic iceberg is moving towards Global City… Citizens ask the mayor to step in and save them from the icy threat.
Rush to the game, save the city and become a hero! You'll surely be rewarded!
As long as it's not too late!

notes.title: Quick Contests
notes.content:
Become the leader of Quick Contests!
Begin the race for the title of the most effective mayor! Load ships, send them to sail, be the first among the neighbors and get rewards right here and now. It will all be sorted out in no time!
You can be the winner!
The event will start on August 19.

notes.title: Marina Bay Sands Hotel
notes.content:
Don't say goodbye to the sunny summer!
Build a magnificent yacht club in the city with a romantic lighthouse and enjoy the refreshing breeze on the top deck of your personal yacht! To build new objects in Global City, you will need Coast Tokens. You will receive them by completing freight orders.
Besides, the finished Yacht Club will increase the bonuses from the Hotel with private beach, which you have probably already built earlier.
Do not miss the opportunity to create a profitable coastal infrastructure!
Enjoy summer in your Global City! The event will start on August 16.

notes.title: Contests for mayors
notes.content:
Quick Contests are ready to launch in the game again!

Wait till the Wheel appears and try your hand.

Become the leader of Quick Contests!
Get ready for the race for the title of the most effective mayor! Load ships, send them to sail, be the first among the neighbors and get rewards right here and now. It will all be sorted out in no time!
You can be the winner! The event starts on August, 8.

notes.title: Monster from the deep
notes.content:
Monster from the deep is at it again!
The port of Global City has been attacked by the terrible Kraken again! We count only on you, mayor! Collect all the necessary resources to repel the attack of the greedy tentacles. Save the ships, cargos, crew and get rewards for your courage!

notes.title: Kuwait Skyscrapers
notes.content:
Fly off to magic fairy tales of the Thousand and one Nights and build unique Kuwait towers in your Global City!
Their shapes resemble fantastic minarets and fluttering clothes of the bedoun… Seeing them once you won't forget the amazing skyscrapers of the Persian Gulf coast.
Be a good genie in your city! Build Al Tijaria Tower, Al Hamra Tower, Liberation Tower, and other unique constructions. The final reward will be to your liking. To make it on time is most significant. Yet, unlike Arabian fairy tales, this won't happen overnight, so you'll surely succeed!

notes.title: New mysteries of old mines
notes.content:
This happens again! The gates of antient mines below Global City are open!
This means new digging and valuable rewards are waiting for you.
Do it right now to make it before the event is over... Find out what treasures are hidden in the dark dungeon.
The exciting adventure begins! Don't miss your chance!

notes.title: Contests for mayors
notes.content:
Quick Contests are in the game again!
Take part in the race of the most enterprising and strong mayors. Load ships, send them out and beat rivals in your group. You should do it all as fast as you can to get great rewards!
Are you ready to prove you're fast, effective, and won't stop? Then come on!

notes.title: Rewards for progress
notes.content:
Start getting crowns right now!
Complete task by task, get crowns, and exchange them for great rewards. The main reward is a wonderful amenity!
Don't forget about the other useful rewards that you can use for the good of Global City!
We wish you good luck!

notes.title: Rewards for luck
notes.content:
An amazing Wheel of Fortune is in the game again!
Rush to Global City to test your luck! Spin the Wheel of Fortune and see what rewards you'll get. You have a chance to get the Gold Chest containing a wonderful architectural masterpiece for your city. Other rewards are also great!
Make your city even more beautiful!

notes.title: Cunning storm
notes.content:
Bad weather in Global City nearly ruined the contests!
The captains of cargo ships watched with dismay the storm that broke out in the bay ... Because of it, the high-speed cargo race was at risk for the whole day. But no winds and waves will prevent enterprising mayors from starting! Yet, it will happen a day later.
However, the anticipation only increases the excitement, right? Get ready to take all the prizes in the Quick Contests!

notes.title: Quick contests
notes.content:
A great race for the most adventurous mayors!
We announce Quick Contests, a high-speed cargo race, in Global City! Take part along with mayors of other cities, complete tasks without leaving the game, load your ships and get valuable rewards.
You can't miss this tournament! Show everyone what you can do and be the first in your group. The rewards will be great!

notes.title: Rewards and tasks
notes.content:
New tasks and new rewards are in the game!
Follow the branches of new task chains and get wonderful prizes! Use them to develop your Global City and make it even more beautiful and prosperous. Reach the final reward - an awesome amenity!
The event starts on June 27.

notes.title: Skyscrapers of Singapore
notes.content:
The holiday season has only just begun!
You've got a chance to decorate your city with the incredible skyscrapers of Singapore. These are magnificent high-rise hotels that will strike every visitor at first glance. You will especially like Marina Bay Sands with a true beach on its top floor. Just imagine being on a beach vacation right below the clouds!
This architectural masterpiece must appear in Global City!

notes.title: Progress and rest
notes.content:
Tune in to progress and don't shrink from challenges!
You've got another chance to get crowns for completing tasks and exchange them for valuable rewards. The main prize is a masterpiece of resort architecture - Hotel Porta Fira!
Don't back down and these wonderful rewards will be yours! Progress always wins!

notes.title: Oil
notes.content:
A huge tanker has run aground on a reef off the coast of Global City. An oil stain is about to cover the bay and only a brave mayor is capable of saving the city from the danger of oil pollution!
Rush to the game and collect resources to remove the terrible stain. Your citizens will be thankful and the rewards will be great!

notes.title: Resort along the coast
notes.content:
The construction of objects for an unforgettable summer holiday goes on!
You can turn Global City into a resort capital, you can’t miss such a chance. Build a marvelous hotel at the seafront of your city: this hotel is just made to admire the sunset and golden beach!
Break into summer and get great rewards, your citizens will be thankful!

notes.title: Hotel and water park
notes.content:
Dive into the hot summer!
Everyone needs a rest, but to have a nice rest you should work hard first. Build a gorgeous hotel, set up a golden beach and open a great water park for your citizens! A lazy rest in a deckchair for some, a groovy slide from water slides for others, and, of course, great rewards for you, mayor!
Go ahead, get to the dizzying summer season!

notes.title: Progress and future
notes.content:
Start earning progress points right now!
Complete task by task, earn points and exchange them for great rewards. The main reward is a replica of the exquisite Museum of the Future of Dubai! This huge building that as if woven of light and steel will become a pearl of your city.
Don't forget about other valuable rewards that you can use for the good of Global City!
Wish you good luck in the game!

notes.title: Ring Road
notes.content:
It's time to implement the most ambitious part of the North-eastern highway project!
You'll finally be able to connect the mountain road to the hydropower plant! This will let you complete the third ring road of your city, unload the city traffic, and give your citizens a comfortable way of visiting tourist sites with their best views. Your Global City will be greatly thankful, and wonderful rewards will wait for you.
Don't waste a minute! Take a leap to new heights!

notes.title: Rewards for lucky
notes.content:
You've got another great chance to tempt fate and get rewards, just sping the Wheel of Fortune!
Among the rewards, you'll be able to get true masterpieces of world architecture from Gold Chests and many other items.
Use every opportunity to make your city even more beautiful!

notes.title: Progress and amenity
notes.content:
Get rewards for progress!
We suggest taking part in an exciting event with valuable rewards. Complete tasks and earn progress points. The more tasks from the chain you complete, the greater your reward will be. And in the finale, you can get a valuable decoration for your city - unique Windmills. They will help your city become even more comfortable and beautiful!
Don't miss your chance, the event is limited in time!

notes.title: North-eastern highway
notes.content:
Implement an incredibly ambitious project of a top-tier North-eastern highway in Global City!
Conquer mountains with the power of science! Build a grand aerial tramway leading its way to the picturesque Mountain complex with a radio telescope! It will help you start space exploration and also give your citizens a unique high-mountain attraction with an incredible view of the hydroelectric power plant watershed!
Don't miss this chance. Complete all the buildings and get valuable prizes and appreciation and delight of your citizens!

notes.title: Mine opens again
notes.content:
Great news: the mysterious mine begins work in the outskirts of the city!
Nobody knows how and when it opens... Yet, one thing is clear: it still has plenty of treasures! Get ready to dig for gold ore and mineral resources! Get items to develop the city as a reward!
Don't waste a moment, the mine will be closed again! The event starts on May, 20.

notes.title: Al Yaqoub Tower
notes.content:
Al Yaqoub skyscraper is one of the most famous hotels in Dubai and it is privately owned. Besides, it's a unique building, indeed.
Incredible, but the architect of it was inspired by the famous English Big Ben! So, you can present your city a combination of oriental exoticism and prim British tradition!
Build the amazing Al Yaqoub Tower in the middle of your Global City and get numerous rewards!

notes.title: The Persistence of Memory
notes.content:
The Persistence of Memory - the persistence of success!
The event with wonderful rewards starts. To get a unique art object and decorate your city, you should complete tasks one by one and get progress points.
Besides, you'll have a chance to get other valuable rewards that would help you develop your Global City!
Don't miss your chance! Success is persistent but sooner or later, the time will run out. Rush to the game, the event is in full swing!

notes.title: Emirates Towers
notes.content:
Exquisite Emirates Towers are the first skyscrapers of the UAE!
They are a true heart of desert, and their amazing edged silhouettes present energy, impetus, upward movement, and an allegiance to tradition. Build them in your Global City, set the city for a jump-start to the future!
Complete the construction of all the incredible skyscrapers of the United Arab Emirates within a given time to get valuable prizes.
Desert power is on your side!

notes.title: Desert Power
notes.content:
Assign without a trace desert power and the depth of the architectural genius of the builders of skyscrapers!
Build unusual Emirates Towers in your Global City, once the first high-rise buildings in the United Arab Emirates! Previously, they offered a view only of the endless sands, and today an ultra-modern metropolis spreads under them. You can also build the Al Yaqoub Tower and Ocean Heights.
Don't miss the chance to decorate your city with all the listed towers and get a valuable reward! The event will start on May 10.

notes.title: Stream of progress
notes.content:
You can't stop the progress!
Use your unique chance to get a wonderful high-tech decoration to your city. Complete a branched chain of tasks, earn progress points, and exchange them for super rewards. In the final, you'll get a grand reward that will seize your citizens' breath once they look at it!
Rush to the game, develop your Global City, and follow the stream of progress!

notes.title: Project completion
notes.content:
The time allotted for constructing the hydropower plant is running out. You've still got your chance to collect Success Points and complete this ambitious project! The reward won't disappoint you, and your citizens will be happy, indeed.
You can't miss this chance to make the life of your favorite city better! Rush to the game and do great things, Global CIty needs a hero!

notes.title: Whirlpool
notes.content:
A gigantic whirlpool is about to destroy all the ships!
Coastal areas of Global City are also at risk! You are the only hope, mayor! If you collect all the needed items, the port and waters of the city can be protected from disaster. Besides, under your guidance, scientists can find a way to eliminate the threat.
Don't waste a moment! You'll get great rewards, and your citizens will be extremely thankful!

notes.title: Hydropower Plant
notes.content:
Who else but the mayor of Global City can earn enough Success Points and present the citizens a new ultra-modern Hydropower Plant?
Begin construction of the dam and build powerful turbines. Complete special tasks, get Success Points, and improve the plant so that your city could shine with myriads of lights!
Do your best to finish construction on time to enjoy the results and rewards!

notes.title: St. Mark's Basilica
notes.content:
The exquisite St. Mark's Basilica will complete the Venetian architectural complex! The image of the cathedral is incredibly completting: it combines East and West, Renaissance and Antiquity, Romanesque and the Byzantine style… Your city is worthy of becoming a setting for such a pearl!
Complete the construction on time to get valuable rewards and become an owner of a true pearl of architecture!

notes.title: Daily progress
notes.content:
Develop your city and get a unique object!
Work hard, advance, and you'll be rewarded! Complete daily tasks and get progress points. Exchange them for valuable prizes and improve your Global City's look! And, of course, get a unique final reward.
We wish you good luck, mayor!

notes.title: Piazza San Marco
notes.content:
Venice’s main square may become the main square of Global City!
Only you can replicate this masterpiece of Renaissance and amaze your citizens, as well as visitors of the city. Make it to the end of the event to build the unique Piazza San Marco in your city and get well-deserved awards.
Exquisite granite columns, Doge’s Palace, and the Biblioteca Marciana will make the look of your Global City unforgettable and romantic!

notes.title: Treasures of Mine
notes.content:
The mine full of treasures is open again!
Mayor, you've got a great chance to start digging in the mysterious mine! Hurry up and start digging for gold and many other items that you can use for developing your city.
The mine will be open not too long... But if you stock up on the tools and won't waste a second, you'll take it all!

notes.title: Venice
notes.content:
There’s no city in the world more romantic than Venice!
And if you move a part of its beauties to Global City, your city will become the second pearl of the Adriatic.
Present an exciting view to the famous Piazza San Marco and its incredible basilica to your citizens! Decorate your Global City with the charming Rialto Bridge under which - you hear? - a gondolier’s singing is about to appear.
Complete orders at the port, collect enough tokens, and open the door to a wonderful Venice fairytale!

notes.title: Japanese Pagoda
notes.content:
Let the citizens meet the pearl of Japan!
You’ve got a great chance to set up a unique and exotic view in Global City and include majestic Japanese Pagoda into the city landscape. It will add to the harmonious ensemble with Japanese Castle and become the place of pilgrimage of crowds of tourists.
It’s so romantic to take a picture against the Pagoda!

notes.title: Wheel of Fortune
notes.content:
Fortune favors those who work hard and rewards them for their patience!
You have been waiting for it and it has come: a mysterious Wheel of Fortune is in your city. Spin it and get a valuable reward. You'll also get a chance to get a Gold Lucky Chest which might contain a unique arcitectural masterpiece!
Don't miss a great chance to make your city better!

notes.title: White Heron Castle
notes.content:
Exotic of the medieval Japan is in your city!
We suggest constructing a true Japanese fortress in your Global City. It’s Himeji, or ‘White Heron Castle’, one of the most ancient perfectly kept fortifications of Japan. Just take a look at its exquisite silhouette and numerous tiers: this masterpiece of medieval architecture will leave no one indifferent.
By the way, the White Heron Castle is a setting for many beautiful Japanese films. Probably, your Global City will also appear in a movie about brave samurai one day!
Yet, to make it happen, you should build the fortress first!

notes.title: Japan
notes.content:
Get ready to meet the distinct architecture of Japan where traditions mix with the height of technology. You’ll be able to replicate a unique skyscraper of the Akihabara district, plant the east garden next to a charming pagoda, and construct a true samurai palace in your Global City.
To start the construction, you’ll need tokens, and you’ll have enough time to collect them. It’s important to start right away and don’t waste any second! An exquisite Japanese corner will draw the attention of visitors of Global City and steal the citizens' hearts!

notes.title: Trade Fair Tower
notes.content:
Go up, go to the future!
This is all about the tremendous Trade Fair Tower - a pearl of modern Frankfurt and your Global City. Have you managed to finish the construction and crown the skyscraper with the pyramidal roof? If not, try doing your best. Your citizens are ready to reward you with a valuable prize!

notes.title: Progress in Global City
notes.content:
Would you like to get a unique amenity in your city?
Rush to the game then! Complete daily tasks, earn progress points and exchange them for valuable prizes! The more tasks you complete, the faster you get unique rewards!
We wish you good luck, mayor!

notes.title: Cologne Cathedral
notes.content:
Do you know the grand masterpiece of German Gothic style, Cologne Cathedral, has been built for more than 600 years? Residents of Global City are sure you'll do it much faster.
And soon, the skyline of your city will be decorated with this magnificent building.
Hurry up, great rewards are waiting for you for constructing all the wonderful Germany's buildings!
Collect tokens and build the city of dreams!

notes.title: Germany
notes.content:
Let your citizens enjoy magic moments alone with Germany’s wonderful and austere architecture! A stroll along Cologne Cathedral and meeting the postmodern greatness of Trade Fair Tower are waiting for you along with other valuable rewards.
Collect tokens, do your best to complete the construction of all the buildings on time, and great rewards will surely be to your liking!

notes.title: Statue of Liberty
notes.content:
Add the final unforgettable touch to your Global City!
Build the astonishing Statue of Liberty in your city - an exact copy of the monument decorating a costline of New York.
By the way, do you know that the statue used to function as a lighthouse? And its torch is covered in 24-carat gold!
Your city should definetely have this symbol of the golden dream!
Finish the Statue of Liberty on time to get valuable prizes and create the atmosphere of "The Big Apple" in your city, the atmosphere of legendary New York!

notes.title: Progress in your city
notes.content:
A unique object must appear in your city!
Rush to the game! Complete daily tasks, get progress points and exchange them for valuable prizes. The more tasks you complete, the higher your chances to get unique rewards are.
Mayor, we wish you good luck!

notes.title: Empire State Building
notes.content:
Empire State Building is a true expression of American Dream!
This unique tower has featured in numerous films starting from Hollywood's golden age. And it's still good!
We suggest you decorating the heart of your city with the replica of the Empire State Building to make your citizens state their golden dream has come true!
Keep on building legendary sights of New York and make your Global City even more unique!
Keep it up to get all the rewards!

notes.title: The Big Apple
notes.content:
Romantic, energetic, always rushing New York with its legendary Statue of Liberty captures the hearts!
We suggest you adding the best sights of New York to your Global City!
Put the legendary skyscrapers and the admiring block of the Lower East Side style amongst your city buildings.
Complete the look of your city with the majestic sculpture in a crown of rays and get all the rewards!

notes.title: Highway complex
notes.content:
The construction of the new highway complex in Global City is in full swing!
It's time to think about how to provide new projects with more energy. This can be done with a nuclear power plant. Global City engineers have just prepared the blueprints for you!
A nuclear power plant is technically a very complex structure, but if you implement this ambitious project, the citizens will be immensely grateful to you!
Start building it right now and get rewards!

notes.title: Volcanic eruption
notes.content:
Attention! Volcano experts warn a huge volcano has been set off near Global City. It's impossible to conquer the force of nature, but you can turn the eruption away from the city.
Find everything you need, assemble collections, and get rewards for your courage!

notes.title: Highway
notes.content:
Great news: Global City engineers developed designs for the newest highway!
If you started constructing it earlier, you can continue building it now and achieve great results. If you didn't start the construction earlier, you've got a great chance to build the grand Eastern Complex!
People need the highway! As well as they need the perfect NPP that will be the result of the construction.
Get ready to take up the challenge and complete all the objects on time! The rewards will be great!

notes.title: Hyperloop
notes.content:
What is the most precious resource, mayor? Time, of course! And the time alloted to constructing a unique means of transport - Hyperloop - it about to end.
It doesn't mean you will not be able to connect your new territories with high-speed trains, but somebody else might get the gifts for the constrution.
Don't let anybody take your title of the master of new technologies! Rush to the game to finish the construction on time and get the rewards!

notes.title: Mine
notes.content: Mayor, the mine is open again in Global City! You've got a great chance to start digging and get gold ore, as well as different items that you can use to develop your city. Rush to the game, stock up on tools, and start looking for treasuries in the mine!

notes.title: Prizes for tasks
notes.content:
Would you like to get a unique amenity in your city?
Rush to the game then! Complete daily tasks, earn progress points and exchange them for valuable prizes! The more tasks you complete, the faster you get unique rewards!
We wish you good luck, mayor!

notes.title: Archaeological excavations
notes.content:
How far back in antiquity goes the history of Global City? It turns out that people always lived in your city... A few thousand years ago mighty Globalpolis existed in this place! You have a chance to make a scientific discovery and reveal all its secrets.
Haven't you made it to finish the excavations last time? Start it again! Dig unique statues, towers, and colonnades out of the ground!
Citizens believe in you, mayor!

notes.title: Expanding the boundaries
notes.content:
Get ready to meet new technologies and new territories!
Did you want to expand the territory of Global City? You are about to do it. We suggest you to build a hyperloop - a unique high-speed vacuum tunnel that will connect the old and new city's regions! Bullet trains moving at a cosmic speed using magnetic levitation is not a dream anymore but a reality. Only you can bring the ambitious project to life!
Rush to the game to start the unique construction!

notes.title: Like in Hollywood cinema
notes.content:
Build the legendary Oriental Pearl TV Tower in your Global City! It looks so great on camera that it has been featured in several top-grossing films… Probably, an eminent director with their film crew will visit your city to see the tower.
But make sure no Kaiju appear from the sea, they really love destroying this tower on the screen!
Rush to the game to complete the construction before the event is over to get valuable prizes!

notes.title: In the path of the tornado
notes.content:
Alarm! Code red! A terrible tornado is getting closer to Global City.
Who will protect the city? Superman or... Super Mayor? A powerful cruiser with advanced weapons is waiting for you in your  arsenal. It can stop the hurricane due to targeted explosions. But to make this plan work you should assemble a lot of collections. Who will handle this important task if not you? Rush to the game, become a hero, and get rewards!

notes.title: On cloud nine
notes.content:
Surprise your citizens and Mayors of other cities with the Shanghai Tower built in your Global City!
This is the highest tower in China and its living legend! The Shanghai Tower rises upwards accumulating the forces of Ancient East and twisting 120 degrees… Its beauty will surely take your breath away. As well as the rewards that you will get for the event!

notes.title: Pearls of Shanghai
notes.content:
A little industrial espionage will never hurt anyone… Especially if secret blueprints of the most popular skyscrapers of Shanghai were delivered to your city thanks to your agents.
Now you can build tremendous towers in your Global City that you will never forget if you once see them. High technology and ancient traditions of the East are so closely intertwined in these buildings that your citizens will fall in love with them immediately!
Fall in love with them, too!

notes.title: Rewards for tasks
notes.content:
During the week complete task by task, develop your city, and get progress points. Collect them to reach certain progress and get valuable prizes. The more tasks you complete, the more progress you gain!
The event will be available for one week only.
Be the first to get the main rewards and gratitude of your citizens!

notes.title: Variety of syles
notes.content:
Architectural sights of London are built in different styles: Gothic Revival, modern, etc. But all of them evoke amazing emotions and make you throw yourself into the romance of the Foggy Albion.
Complete the construction of all the buildings to create an integrated view and enjoy the perfection!
Make it before the event is over, please the citizens and get great rewards!

notes.title: Unique skyscraper
notes.content:
Have you agreed to experiment with form and style?
30 St Mary Axe is justly considered the most eco-friendly skyscraper in the world. Its unusual aerodynamic shape and glass cover allow it to save a huge amount of electricity through the use of sunlight and air streams.
Are you ready to build it in your city? Don’t waste your time, the beauties of London will not be built without you!

notes.title: Beauty of London
notes.content:
We invite you for a stroll along London streets, Mayor!
Pardon? Are you busy with Global City affairs? Not a problem! If you cannot go to London, then London can go to your city!
You’ve got a unique opportunity to build the famous Westminster palace in your city, along with controversial but yet beautiful in its own way 30 St Mary Axe, and, of course, the main symbol of Britain - Big Ben!
Complete the construction of all the objects to get valuable prizes. Enjoy the magnificent architectural structures!

notes.title: Hurry up to decorate the Christmas tree!
notes.content:
The time is running out!
Rush to the game to decorate the Christmas tree and give the residents of Global City an incredible winter festival!
Work your way down deep into the mine to find more ornaments. Rewards and the citizens’ gratitude are waiting for you!

notes.title: Iceberg
notes.content:
Help! A gigantic iceberg is moving towards Global City… Citizens ask the mayor to step in and save them from the icy threat. This winter snow and ice should bring happiness, not troubles.
Rush to the game, save the city and become a hero! You’ll surely be rewarded!
As long as it’s not too late!

notes.title: Congratulation
notes.content:
Dear Mayor!
We would like to congratulate you very warmly on the wonderful winter holidays! You mean a lot to us, so we would like to give you a valuable gift that will be useful in your city.
Check the game to accept it.
We wish you happiness and success in the New Year!
Best wishes, Global City Team

notes.title: Holidays are coming!
notes.content:
Have you revealed secrets of the mysterious mine?
Remember that it hides not only unique ornaments, but real treasures…
Still, you should make efforts to find them.
Rush to the game! Collect all the needed ornaments, find valuable rewards and arrange a true festival for the citizens.
Only you can gift Global City a true magic!

notes.title: Christmas
notes.content:
Mayor, do you believe in magic?
It’s going to happen in your city… If you help!
A magic Christmas tree has come to your city from legendary Lapland. And you should decorate it with special ornaments. Rumor has it, unique ornaments can be found in a secret mine in the east of the city. By the way, you can also find real treasures in the mine!
Uncover all the mysteries of the magic mine and prepare your city for an unforgettable celebration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41543593/f5dd075d4251d20d89050e73f32382f9b6746012.png[/img]

notes.title: Spain
notes.content:
Rush to Global City to finish the construction of Casa Batlló and the Sagrada Família! The Spanish have been constructing this unique building for 140 years but you have a chance to do it faster and receive great rewards! They will be especially welcome on the eve of the winter holidays.
Treasures of Barcelona are waiting for you in the game!

notes.title: Spain
notes.content:
Don’t miss a unique chance to decorate your Global City with an exact replica of the famous creation of Antonio Gaudi: Casa Batlló that was built by a genius for a textile magnate. This unique house will become the center of attention in your city. Besides, many other amazing buildings and valuable rewards are waiting for you!
Rush to the game, feel the Christmas fairytale vibe!

notes.title: Spain
notes.content:
As is well known, the Sagrada Familia cathedral that has been built for almost 140 years was crowned with a great Christmas star not long ago… And this is a reason to build an exact replica of the Sagrada Familia in your city as well as construct other Gaudi’s masterpieces there!
Dive into a December fairytale together with the legendary creations of the Spanish genius!

notes.title: Hints and tips: switching language
notes.content:
To change the language, open the Settings menu (the gear button on the right side of the screen).
In the Settings, choose the globe icon.
In the drop-down menu, choose the language you need and put a check mark next to it.

notes.title: Hints and tips: full screen
notes.content:
Dear Mayors!

Since the release of the game some of you wondered about the full screen mode, so we prepared a small guide for you.

You can switch the game to full screen mode by using the blue button with two arrows, that is located next to the panel with your amount of coins in the upper right corner.
